name: mcp-server-dev
description: Go-first, standards-first skills for designing and releasing portable MCP servers, MCP Apps, and local MCPB bundles.

interface.shortDescription: Build portable Go-first MCP servers and MCP Apps
interface.longDescription: Use Codex to design and implement standards-first MCP servers, add TypeScript MCP App UI only when it improves the workflow, validate behavior in ChatGPT and other compatible clients, and package true local-machine servers without coupling the released core to one host.
defaultPrompt: Design a portable remote MCP server with Go, stateless Streamable HTTP, precise tools, and a real release validation plan.
Add a standards-first TypeScript MCP App UI to an existing Go MCP server without making the UI or ChatGPT extensions mandatory.
Review an MCP repository for protocol, host portability, security, packaging, and release readiness.
Package a true local-machine Go MCP server as a platform-specific MCPB binary.
